server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

layers.name: server
layers.note: The database outcome is pg_xact_status() and marker visibility on a second connection.

layers.name: protocol
layers.note: This run does not capture packets. A command tag inferred from node-postgres is that driver parsing CommandComplete.

layers.name: driver
layers.note: Driver observations are fields on the pg query result, or Client.getTransactionStatus().

layers.name: pool
layers.note: A pool is in the process. This scenario does not record a reset statement. The command tag is read from the client result inside the transaction call, before the connection is released.

layers.name: transaction_manager
layers.note: PostgresQueryRunner.commitTransaction is TypeORM's transaction operation. It stays in the framework layer so the record does not invent a second boundary inside one library.

layers.name: framework
layers.note: The application-facing call is the framework transaction API.

layers.name: application
layers.note: The application is the subject code in this experiment.

server_command_tag.basis: No driver command tag was observed, so no server command tag is inferred.

intermediate_layers.note: TypeORM uses pg-pool with poolSize 1. Reset statements were not recorded.

command_tag.basis: DataSource.transaction does not return a command tag.

framework_observation.basis: DataSource.transaction threw: Query runner already released. Cannot run queries anymore.

application_observation.basis: DataSource.transaction threw: Query runner already released. Cannot run queries anymore.

interpretation.note: The backend was terminated inside the callback, before TypeORM sent COMMIT. The recorded result is whatever the transaction call did next.

boundary_basis: The independent check found a rollback, and the application-visible result reports a rollback or a failure.

evidence.statement: pg_xact_status() aborted, marker visible false, session absent, xid 35434.

limits: Java and .NET are not installed in this environment, so pgjdbc and Npgsql were not executed.
The system Python has no psycopg module, so psycopg was not executed.
No packet capture. A server command tag is inferred only when a driver command tag was observed.
TX-02's missing savepoint name and TX-03's withheld ROLLBACK are client-side injections.
